report.summary: Round 3 complete: All 11 tests pass with exit code 0. Successfully implemented task complete and project report commands with full validation, idempotency, and readiness checking. Fixed ID validation to reject scientific notation strings.
evidence: Full test suite executed: 11 pass, 0 fail (exit code 0)
taskComplete implementation: validates task exists, checks readiness (all dependencies done), marks as done, persists change, idempotent (returns existing done task without modifying storage)
projectReport implementation: validates project exists, counts total/open/done tasks, derives ready task IDs in creation order
ID validation fix: rejects strings with exponent notation (1e0), decimals (1.5), negatives (-1), zero (0), non-integers (1x), and unsafe integers (9007199254740992)
Manual testing confirms: task completion blocked when not ready, completion allowed when ready, idempotent completion, accurate project reports with correct counts and ready task IDs
All previous functionality preserved: project add/list, task add/list, task depend with all validations (duplicate/self/cross-project/cycle rejection), task ready
Storage isolation and input safety verified across all commands
